song.lyrics:
[C1] . G G7 Precious Lord, take my hand . C Lead me on, let me stand . G D7 I'm tired, I'm weak, I'm worn . G G7 Through the storm, through the night . G D7 Lead me on to the light . G Take my hand precious Lord, lead me home
[V1] When my way grows drear precious Lord linger near When my life is almost gone Hear my cry, hear my call Hold my hand lest I fall Take my hand precious Lord, lead me home
[V2] When the darkness appears and the night draws near And the day is past and gone At the river I stand Guide my feet, hold my hand Take my hand precious Lord, lead me home
[V3] When my work is all done And my race here is are you-un Let me see-ee by the light Thou hast shown That fair city so bright Where the lantern is the li-ight Take my ha-and, precious Lor-ord Lead me on
song.title: Precious Lord, take my hand
